surfaces.label: API authentication, authorization, and organization isolation
surfaces.notes: Reviewed authenticated route guards, workspace resolution, membership roles, internal-route secrets, object-scoped queries, and CSRF origin enforcement.
surfaces.riskArea: Broken access control and tenant data exposure

surfaces.label: Payment policy, approvals, reservations, and audit integrity
surfaces.notes: Reviewed policy evaluation, approval flows, transactional spend reservations, immutable fingerprints, submission recovery incidents, and database-enforced hash chaining.
surfaces.riskArea: Unauthorized or duplicate spend and audit tampering

surfaces.label: Outbound resource, fulfillment, health, and notification HTTP
surfaces.notes: Candidate candidate-b878526e40d2b165 was suppressed after source tracing and regression tests proved public-IP validation plus connection-time DNS pinning at every identified sink.

surfaces.label: Session, OAuth, wallet, and browser security controls
surfaces.notes: Candidate candidate-56afbf8a791bb046 was suppressed because production cookies are host-bound and JWT verification fixes algorithm, issuer, and audience.
surfaces.riskArea: Session confusion, cookie shadowing, and token substitution

surfaces.label: Credential encryption and key material
surfaces.notes: Candidate candidate-8d8153bf200ebd90 was suppressed after exact 32-byte production-key validation, authenticated v2 encryption, tamper tests, and isolated v1 read compatibility.
surfaces.riskArea: Credential disclosure and weak cryptographic keys

surfaces.label: Hedera and Arc signing, settlement, contract execution, and error handling
surfaces.notes: Candidates candidate-986d2dafe67d7e5d and candidate-b6710f43bdb97de4 were suppressed by production fail-closed key separation, cross-capability rejection tests, bounded bodies, contract allowlists, and stable public error codes.
surfaces.riskArea: Privileged capability escalation and sensitive error disclosure

surfaces.label: Dependencies, CI, containers, Compose, and Render blueprint
surfaces.notes: Production audit reports zero vulnerabilities; npm is pinned; clean installs and all production images build; runtime containers use UID 1000 and pass health/restart tests.
surfaces.riskArea: Known vulnerable dependencies, non-reproducible builds, and privileged runtimes

surfaces.label: Prisma migrations, seed behavior, governance checks, and recovery
surfaces.notes: All 22 migrations are current; fresh and configured states were exercised; governance verification passed; the configured remote public schema restored locally with 60 tables and 22 migrations.
surfaces.riskArea: Schema drift, unrecoverable data, and broken integrity controls
